description: jest-mock-extended 4 (T11.11, T4.11's Jest half), on two files under one worker so the second file sees a package the worker loaded for the first. It builds its mocks from `@jest/globals`' `jest.fn` (a served module) and reads `jest-mock`'s types: `mock<T>()` with `calledWith` on literals, `any()` and `anyString()`, `mockDeep` with a nested `calledWith`, `mockReset`, `mockClear`, and failing `toHaveBeenCalledWith` and `toHaveBeenCalledTimes` on a mock's member. Read by `provino`'s `ecosystem-matchers.test.ts`.
